drafted_from: tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me's own row and test/waiting-records.test.mjs, whose runs answered the values shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Mark record:waiting-on-you:sample-signed-form done under request key sample-completion." It runs tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me, works out the declared completion of that same record and answers the write that keeps it; the AI sends the write and reads the record back.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing and writes nothing: its answer holds the completion of the waiting record you hand in, by its source's declared completion.
instructions: 1. Take the card ids from tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me, read those records with records:read at @own-records, and pick a fresh request_key.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me and { ids, request_key, records }.
3. Read completed and changed, and send write at @own-records with records:write; a record that already carries the key answers changed 0 and an empty write.
4. Read the records again and confirm with tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion and the same ids and request_key.

worked_examples.title: An ask is marked done, and a retry is safe
worked_examples.ask: I signed the form; mark it done.
worked_examples.given: From test/waiting-records.test.mjs: one record:waiting-on-you row with status Waiting.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered {"completed":["record:waiting-on-you:sample-signed-form"],"changed":1,"write":[...]} where write holds the record with status "Done" expecting the value it was read with; handed the record with that receipt, it answers changed 0 and an empty write.
